events.text: The municipality of Malvik was established in 1891 and was separated from Strinda.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The municipality of Malvik was established in 1891 when it was separated from the large municipality of Strinda

events.text: A small area of Lånke was transferred to Malvik on 1 January 1914.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 1914 , a small area of the neighboring municipality of Lånke ( population : 38 ) was transferred to Malvik

events.text: A small area of Malvik was transferred to Strinda on 1 July 1953.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1953 , a small area of Malvik ( population : 37 ) was transferred to the neighboring municipality of Strinda

events.text: The municipality switched from Sør-Trøndelag county to Trøndelag county on 1 January 2018.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 2018 , the municipality switched from the old Sør-Trøndelag county to the new Trøndelag county

events.text: The coat of arms was granted on 23 July 1982.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The coat of arms was granted on 23 July 1982

events.text: The area around Vikhammer and Hundhammeren has grown larger than Hommelvik.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the last few decades the area around Vikhammer and Hundhammeren ( about to the west ) has grown larger than Hommelvik .
